decisions.because: Counterexample (hunt round 3, 2026-10-10): a gobgp -j reply naming one destination twice (a foreign local path, then []) parsed as a healthy empty RIB, and the round wrote over the foreign path (FLOWSPEC-R3, R4).

statement: A RIB read that repeats an object key at any level is unusable: it classifies no path and authorizes no write.
